input.content:
"""Run MikroTik CHR (free license) locally as NetCortex's test router.

    uv run python infra/chr/chr.py start   # boot; the first run also provisions and saves a baseline
    uv run python infra/chr/chr.py reset   # restore the baseline disk and boot again
    uv run python infra/chr/chr.py stop
    uv run python infra/chr/chr.py status

The image pin, QEMU flags and serial-console provisioning follow the partner's CI script
(.github/scripts/chr_bootstrap.py). Differences: the serial console is a TCP socket (works
on Windows), acceleration is WHPX on Windows / KVM on Linux / TCG otherwise, there are three
NICs (ether1 primary uplink, ether2 backup uplink, ether3 LAN), and the admin password comes
from CHR_PASSWORD in .env. Everything listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Disks live in var/chr/.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import re
import shutil
import socket
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
import zipfile
from pathlib import Path

import httpx

from netcortex_core import get_settings

VERSION = "7.24.5"
IMAGE_URL = f"https://download.mikrotik.com/routeros/{VERSION}/chr-{VERSION}.img.zip"
IMAGE_SHA256 = "16f07222a3213352c9c4fbea4f4dec6a8ffb78fdc0fa5e398c23103ed357c6eb"

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
WORK = ROOT / "var" / "chr"
IMAGE_ZIP = WORK / f"chr-{VERSION}.img.zip"
PRISTINE = WORK / f"chr-{VERSION}.img"  # as downloaded, never written
DISK = WORK / "chr.qcow2"  # the running router's disk (overlay on PRISTINE)
BASELINE = WORK / "baseline.qcow2"  # DISK right after provisioning + baseline.rsc
PID_FILE = WORK / "qemu.pid"
LOG_FILE = WORK / "qemu.log"
BASELINE_RSC = Path(__file__).with_name("baseline.rsc")

REST_PORT, SSH_PORT, SERIAL_PORT = 9180, 9122, 9123
REST_URL = f"http://127.0.0.1:{REST_PORT}"
BOOT_TIMEOUT_S = 300

ANSI = re.compile(r"\x1b(?:\[[0-?]*[ -/]*[@-~]|\][^\x07]*(?:\x07|\x1b\\)|[@-Z\\-_])")


class ChrError(RuntimeError):
    pass


# --- Image ----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def ensure_image() -> None:
    WORK.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if not IMAGE_ZIP.exists():
        print(f"Downloading CHR {VERSION} ...", flush=True)
        with urllib.request.urlopen(IMAGE_URL, timeout=60) as response:
            IMAGE_ZIP.write_bytes(response.read())
    if hashlib.sha256(IMAGE_ZIP.read_bytes()).hexdigest() != IMAGE_SHA256:
        IMAGE_ZIP.unlink()
        raise ChrError("CHR image does not match the pinned SHA-256; deleted it")
    if not PRISTINE.exists():
        with zipfile.ZipFile(IMAGE_ZIP) as bundle:
            [name] = [n for n in bundle.namelist() if n.endswith(".img")]
            PRISTINE.write_bytes(bundle.read(name))


# --- QEMU -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


def qemu_binary(name: str) -> str:
    found = shutil.which(name) or shutil.which(f"{name}.exe")
    if found:
        return found
    windows = Path(r"C:\Program Files\qemu") / f"{name}.exe"
    if windows.exists():
        return str(windows)
    raise ChrError(f"{name} not found; install QEMU (winget install SoftwareFreedomConservancy.QEMU)")


def accelerators() -> list[list[str]]:
    """Acceleration options to try, fastest first."""
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        return [["-accel", "whpx,kernel-irqchip=off"], ["-accel", "tcg"]]
    if Path("/dev/kvm").exists():
        return [["-accel", "kvm", "-cpu", "host"], ["-accel", "tcg"]]
    return [["-accel", "tcg"]]


def qemu_command(accel: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    command = [qemu_binary("qemu-system-x86_64"), "-M", "q35", "-m", "256", "-smp", "1", *accel]
    command += ["-drive", f"file={DISK},format=qcow2,if=virtio"]
    forwards = f"hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:{REST_PORT}-:80,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:{SSH_PORT}-:22"
    command += ["-netdev", f"user,id=net0,{forwards}", "-device", "virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0"]
    for nic in (1, 2):  # ether2 (backup uplink) and ether3 (LAN): isolated, config only
        command += ["-netdev", f"user,id=net{nic},restrict=on"]
        command += ["-device", f"virtio-net-pci,netdev=net{nic}"]
    command += ["-display", "none", "-monitor", "none", "-no-reboot"]
    command += ["-chardev", f"socket,id=s0,host=127.0.0.1,port={SERIAL_PORT},server=on,wait=off"]
    command += ["-serial", "chardev:s0"]
    return command


def launch() -> None:
    """Start QEMU in the background, trying each accelerator until one stays up."""
    flags = 0
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        flags = subprocess.CREATE_NEW_PROCESS_GROUP | subprocess.DETACHED_PROCESS
    for accel in accelerators():
        log = LOG_FILE.open("ab")
        process = subprocess.Popen(
            qemu_command(accel), stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL, stdout=log, stderr=log,
            creationflags=flags, start_new_session=sys.platform != "win32",
        )  # fmt: skip
        time.sleep(3)
        if process.poll() is None:
            PID_FILE.write_text(str(process.pid))
            print(f"QEMU started ({' '.join(accel[1:2])}), pid {process.pid}", flush=True)
            return
        print(f"QEMU exited with {' '.join(accel[1:2])}; trying the next accelerator", flush=True)
    raise ChrError(f"QEMU would not start; see {LOG_FILE}")


def qemu_running() -> bool:
    if not PID_FILE.exists():
        return False
    pid = PID_FILE.read_text().strip()
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        found = subprocess.run(
            ["tasklist", "/FI", f"PID eq {pid}", "/FO", "CSV", "/NH"],
            capture_output=True, text=True, check=False,
        ).stdout  # fmt: skip
        return "qemu-system-x86_64" in found
    return Path(f"/proc/{pid}").exists()


def kill_qemu() -> None:
    if qemu_running():
        pid = PID_FILE.read_text().strip()
        if sys.platform == "win32":
            subprocess.run(["taskkill", "/PID", pid, "/F"], capture_output=True, check=False)
        else:
            subprocess.run(["kill", pid], check=False)
    PID_FILE.unlink(missing_ok=True)


# --- RouterOS -------------------------------------------------------------------------


def credentials() -> tuple[str, str]:
    settings = get_settings()
    if settings.chr_password is None:
        raise ChrError("Set CHR_PASSWORD in .env (a local-only value) before starting CHR")
    return settings.chr_username or "admin", settings.chr_password.get_secret_value()


def rest_ready(username: str, password: str) -> bool:
    try:
        response = httpx.get(
            f"{REST_URL}/rest/system/resource", auth=(username, password), timeout=3
        )
        return response.status_code == 200 and bool(response.json().get("board-name"))
    except (httpx.HTTPError, ValueError):
        return False


def wait_for_rest(username: str, password: str, timeout_s: float = BOOT_TIMEOUT_S) -> None:
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        if rest_ready(username, password):
            return
        time.sleep(2)
    raise ChrError("CHR REST API did not answer in time")


def run_script(username: str, password: str, script: str) -> str:
    response = httpx.post(
        f"{REST_URL}/rest/execute",
        auth=(username, password),
        json={"script": script, "as-string": ""},
        timeout=30,
    )
    if response.status_code != 200:
        raise ChrError(f"RouterOS rejected the script: {response.text[:300]}")
    return response.json().get("ret", "")


def provision(password: str, timeout_s: float = BOOT_TIMEOUT_S) -> None:
    """First boot: log in on the serial console, set the admin password, enable REST."""
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
    while True:
        try:
            console = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", SERIAL_PORT), timeout=2)
            break
        except OSError:
            if time.monotonic() > deadline:
                raise ChrError("serial console did not open") from None
            time.sleep(0.5)
    steps = [  # (prompt to wait for, line to send); prompts are case-insensitive
        (r"login:\s*$", "admin"),
        (r"password:\s*$", ""),
        (r"software license.*\[y/n\]:?\s*$|new password>?\s*$", None),
    ]
    with console:
        buffer = _expect(console, steps[0][0], deadline)
        _send(console, steps[0][1])
        _expect(console, steps[1][0], deadline)
        _send(console, steps[1][1])
        seen = _expect(console, r"\[y/n\]:?\s*$|new password>?\s*$", deadline)
        if re.search(r"\[y/n\]", seen, re.I):
            _send(console, "n")
            seen = _expect(console, r"new password>?\s*$|enter to continue", deadline)
            if re.search(r"enter to continue", seen, re.I):
                _send(console, "")
                _expect(console, r"new password>?\s*$", deadline)
        _send(console, password)
        _expect(console, r"repeat new password>?\s*$", deadline)
        _send(console, password)
        _expect(console, r"\] >\s*$", deadline)
        _send(console, "/ip service set [find name=www] disabled=no")
        buffer = _expect(console, r"\] >\s*$", deadline)
        if re.search(r"bad command|syntax error|failure:", buffer, re.I):
            raise ChrError("RouterOS rejected enabling the www (REST) service")


def _send(console: socket.socket, line: str) -> None:
    console.sendall(line.encode() + b"\r")


def _expect(console: socket.socket, pattern: str, deadline: float) -> str:
    buffer = ""
    regex = re.compile(pattern, re.I | re.M)
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        console.settimeout(1)
        try:
            chunk = console.recv(4096)
        except TimeoutError:
            continue
        buffer += ANSI.sub("", chunk.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")).replace("\r", "")
        if regex.search(buffer):
            return buffer
    raise ChrError(f"timed out on the serial console waiting for /{pattern}/")


def apply_baseline(username: str, password: str) -> None:
    lines = [
        line.strip()
        for line in BASELINE_RSC.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()
        if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#")
    ]
    run_script(username, password, "\n".join(lines))


def shutdown(username: str, password: str) -> None:
    """Power off cleanly so RouterOS flushes its config to disk; kill if it hangs."""
    try:
        httpx.post(f"{REST_URL}/rest/system/shutdown", auth=(username, password), timeout=5)
    except httpx.HTTPError:
        pass  # the connection often drops as it powers off
    deadline = time.monotonic() + 60
    while qemu_running() and time.monotonic() < deadline:
        time.sleep(1)
    kill_qemu()


# --- Commands -------------------------------------------------------------------------


def start() -> None:
    username, password = credentials()
    if qemu_running() and rest_ready(username, password):
        print(f"CHR is already running: {REST_URL}")
        return
    kill_qemu()
    ensure_image()
    started = time.monotonic()
    if not BASELINE.exists():
        print("First start: provisioning CHR and saving a baseline ...", flush=True)
        DISK.unlink(missing_ok=True)
        subprocess.run(
            [qemu_binary("qemu-img"), "create", "-q", "-f", "qcow2", "-b", PRISTINE.name,
             "-F", "raw", str(DISK)],
            check=True, cwd=WORK,
        )  # fmt: skip
        launch()
        provision(password)
        wait_for_rest(username, password)
        apply_baseline(username, password)
        shutdown(username, password)
        shutil.copyfile(DISK, BASELINE)
    elif not DISK.exists():
        shutil.copyfile(BASELINE, DISK)
    launch()
    wait_for_rest(username, password)
    print(f"CHR is up after {time.monotonic() - started:.0f}s: {REST_URL} (SSH on {SSH_PORT})")


def reset() -> None:
    username, password = credentials()
    if not BASELINE.exists():
        raise ChrError("No baseline yet; run start first")
    if qemu_running():
        shutdown(username, password)
    shutil.copyfile(BASELINE, DISK)
    print("Restored the baseline disk", flush=True)
    start()


def stop() -> None:
    username, password = credentials()
    if qemu_running():
        shutdown(username, password)
    print("CHR stopped")


def status() -> None:
    username, password = credentials()
    running = qemu_running()
    print(f"QEMU running: {running}; REST answering: {running and rest_ready(username, password)}")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Run the local CHR test router.")
    parser.add_argument("command", choices=["start", "reset", "stop", "status"])
    command = parser.parse_args().command
    try:
        {"start": start, "reset": reset, "stop": stop, "status": status}[command]()
    except ChrError as exc:
        print(f"CHR error: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Test a fix on the CHR test router before a human sees it, and apply it after approval.

dry_run: export -> apply -> export and diff -> roll back -> export and compare with the
original. A fix passes only if it applied cleanly, changed something, and rolled back to
exactly the original config.
"""

import difflib
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

from netcortex_core import FixPlan, Settings, TemplateId, db, get_settings
from netcortex_fixes.router import RouterClient, RouterError
from netcortex_fixes.templates import get_template, render, validate


@dataclass
class DryRun:
    ok: bool
    params: dict[str, Any]  # validated, including values read from the router
    commands: str
    rollback: str
    diff: list[str]  # config lines the fix added (+) or removed (-)
    log: str


def router_params(template_id: TemplateId, client: RouterClient) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Params the template takes from the router itself (set_by: router)."""
    wanted = {
        name for name, spec in get_template(template_id).params.items() if spec.set_by == "router"
    }
    values: dict[str, Any] = {}
    if "previous_servers" in wanted:
        servers = client.get("/ip/dns").get("servers", "")
        values["previous_servers"] = [s for s in servers.split(",") if s]
    return values


def _diff(before: list[str], after: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [
        line
        for line in difflib.unified_diff(before, after, lineterm="", n=0)
        if line[:1] in "+-" and not line.startswith(("+++", "---"))
    ]


def dry_run(template_id: TemplateId | str, params: dict[str, Any], client: RouterClient) -> DryRun:
    template_id = TemplateId(template_id)
    if template_id is TemplateId.NONE:
        return DryRun(True, {}, "", "", [], "Template none: no router change to test.")
    params = validate(template_id, params | router_params(template_id, client))
    commands, rollback = render(template_id, params)
    log = [f"Dry run of {template_id.value} on CHR at {datetime.now(UTC):%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S} UTC"]

    before = client.export()
    try:
        log.append(client.run(commands))
        applied = True
    except RouterError as exc:
        log.append(f"APPLY FAILED: {exc}")
        applied = False
    after = client.export()
    diff = _diff(before, after)
    log.append("Config change:\n" + ("\n".join(diff) or "(none)"))

    try:
        log.append(client.run(rollback))
        rolled_back = True
    except RouterError as exc:
        log.append(f"ROLLBACK FAILED: {exc}")
        rolled_back = False
    leftover = _diff(before, client.export())
    if leftover:
        log.append("NOT RESTORED, differences from the original:\n" + "\n".join(leftover))

    checks = {
        "applied cleanly": applied,
        "changed the config": bool(diff),
        "rolled back cleanly": rolled_back,
        "config restored exactly": not leftover,
    }
    log.append("; ".join(f"{name}: {'yes' if ok else 'NO'}" for name, ok in checks.items()))
    return DryRun(all(checks.values()), params, commands, rollback, diff, "\n".join(log))


def check_fix(
    incident_id: UUID,
    template_id: TemplateId | str,
    params: dict[str, Any],
    client: RouterClient | None = None,
    settings: Settings | None = None,
) -> FixPlan:
    """Dry-run a proposed fix on CHR and store the result in fix_plans."""
    client = client or RouterClient.chr(settings)
    try:
        result = dry_run(template_id, params, client)
        plan = FixPlan(
            incident_id=incident_id,
            template_id=TemplateId(template_id),
            params=result.params,
            commands=result.commands,
            rollback=result.rollback,
            dry_run_ok=result.ok,
            dry_run_log=result.log,
        )
    except RouterError as exc:  # CHR down: the plan is stored as not tested
        commands, rollback = render(template_id, params)
        plan = FixPlan(
            incident_id=incident_id,
            template_id=TemplateId(template_id),
            params=params,
            commands=commands,
            rollback=rollback,
            dry_run_ok=False,
            dry_run_log=f"Dry run could not run: {exc}",
        )
    with db.get_pool(settings).connection() as conn:
        db.insert_fix_plan(conn, plan)
    return plan


def _target(settings: Settings | None) -> Settings:
    settings = settings or get_settings()
    if settings.apply_target != "chr":
        raise RouterError("Only APPLY_TARGET=chr is supported; real routers are not wired up")
    return settings


def apply(plan: FixPlan, client: RouterClient | None = None, settings: Settings | None = None) -> str:
    """Apply an approved, dry-run-tested fix to the CHR test router."""
    if plan.decision != "approved":
        raise RouterError("Refusing to apply a fix that has not been approved")
    if not plan.dry_run_ok:
        raise RouterError("Refusing to apply a fix that did not pass its dry run")
    client = client or RouterClient.chr(_target(settings))
    return client.run(plan.commands)


def rollback(plan: FixPlan, client: RouterClient | None = None, settings: Settings | None = None) -> str:
    """Undo an applied fix on the CHR test router."""
    client = client or RouterClient.chr(_target(settings))
    return client.run(plan.rollback)

"""Dry-run every fix template on the CHR test router.

    uv run python infra/chr/test_templates.py [--json results.json]

For each template: apply it with valid sample params, check the config change contains
what the template should add, roll back, and check the config matches the baseline again.
Exits 1 if any template fails. Reads CHR_REST_URL, CHR_USERNAME and CHR_PASSWORD
(CHR_REST_USERNAME / CHR_REST_PASSWORD also work, for the CI bootstrap).
"""

import argparse
import json
import sys
import time

from netcortex_fixes import RouterClient, RouterError, dry_run, load_templates
from netcortex_core import TemplateId

# Sample params that fit infra/chr/baseline.rsc, and lines each fix must add.
SAMPLES = {
    TemplateId.QUEUE_LIMIT: (
        {"target": "10.0.0.42", "upload_mbps": 5, "download_mbps": 10},
        ["+/queue simple add", "name=netcortex-limit-10.0.0.42", "max-limit=5M/10M"],
    ),
    TemplateId.FAILOVER_ROUTE: (
        {"primary_gateway": "10.0.2.2", "backup_gateway": "192.0.2.1"},
        ["check-gateway=ping", "gateway=192.0.2.1", "netcortex:failover_route"],
    ),
    TemplateId.PRIORITY_QUEUE: (
        {"uplink": "ether1", "uplink_mbps": 90},
        ["new-packet-mark=netcortex-priority", "name=netcortex-uplink", "packet-mark=no-mark"],
    ),
    TemplateId.DNS_SERVERS: (
        {"servers": ["1.1.1.1", "8.8.8.8"]},
        ["servers=1.1.1.1,8.8.8.8"],
    ),
}


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__.splitlines()[0])
    parser.add_argument("--json", help="write machine-readable results to this file")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    try:
        client = RouterClient.chr()
        baseline = client.export()
    except RouterError as exc:
        print(f"CHR not reachable: {exc}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1

    results = []
    for template_id in (t for t in load_templates() if t is not TemplateId.NONE):
        params, expected = SAMPLES[template_id]
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            result = dry_run(template_id, params, client)
            added = "\n".join(result.diff)
            missing = [marker for marker in expected if marker not in added]
            ok = result.ok and not missing
            detail = result.log + (f"\nMissing from the change: {missing}" if missing else "")
        except RouterError as exc:
            ok, detail = False, f"Router error: {exc}"
        restored = client.export() == baseline
        ok = ok and restored
        seconds = round(time.monotonic() - started, 1)
        print(f"{'PASS' if ok else 'FAIL'}  {template_id.value:15} {seconds:5.1f}s", flush=True)
        if not ok:
            print("      " + detail.replace("\n", "\n      "))
        results.append({"template": template_id.value, "ok": ok, "seconds": seconds, "log": detail})

    if args.json:
        with open(args.json, "w", encoding="utf-8") as output:
            json.dump(results, output, indent=2)
    failed = [r["template"] for r in results if not r["ok"]]
    print(f"{len(results) - len(failed)}/{len(results)} templates passed on CHR")
    return 1 if failed else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

from uuid import uuid4

import pytest
from netcortex_core import FixPlan, TemplateId

from netcortex_fixes import RouterClient, apply, dry_run, rollback

pytestmark = pytest.mark.live

QUEUE = {"target": "10.0.0.42", "upload_mbps": 5, "download_mbps": 10}


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def chr_router():
    client = RouterClient.chr()
    yield client
    client.close()


def test_dry_run_on_chr_restores_the_config(chr_router):
    before = chr_router.export()
    result = dry_run(TemplateId.QUEUE_LIMIT, QUEUE, chr_router)
    assert result.ok, result.log
    assert chr_router.export() == before


def test_approved_fix_applies_and_rolls_back_on_chr(chr_router):
    before = chr_router.export()
    tested = dry_run(TemplateId.QUEUE_LIMIT, QUEUE, chr_router)
    plan = FixPlan(
        incident_id=uuid4(),
        template_id=TemplateId.QUEUE_LIMIT,
        params=tested.params,
        commands=tested.commands,
        rollback=tested.rollback,
        dry_run_ok=tested.ok,
        decision="approved",
    )
    try:
        apply(plan, chr_router)
        assert any("netcortex-limit-10.0.0.42" in line for line in chr_router.export())
    finally:
        rollback(plan, chr_router)
    assert chr_router.export() == before

input.content:
# CHR test router

A MikroTik Cloud Hosted Router (RouterOS 7.24.5, free license, 1 Mbit/s cap) in QEMU. Every
fix is dry-run here before a human sees it, and in the demo, approved fixes are applied
here. Nothing touches a real router.

## Setup (once)

1. Install QEMU. On Windows: `winget install SoftwareFreedomConservancy.QEMU`.
2. Put the router settings in `.env`. `CHR_PASSWORD` is a local-only value you choose; never
   commit it.

   ```
   CHR_REST_URL=http://127.0.0.1:9180
   CHR_USERNAME=admin
   CHR_PASSWORD=<random, local only>
   ```

## Use

| Windows (PowerShell) | Linux / macOS / Git Bash | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `infra\chr\start.ps1` | `sh infra/chr/start.sh` | Boot CHR. The first run downloads the pinned image (SHA-256 checked), sets the admin password on the serial console, applies `baseline.rsc` and saves `var/chr/baseline.qcow2` (about 2 min). Later starts take 30–50 s. |
| `infra\chr\reset.ps1` | `sh infra/chr/reset.sh` | Restore the baseline disk and boot again (about 50 s) |
| `infra\chr\stop.ps1` | `sh infra/chr/stop.sh` | Clean shutdown |

Then:

```bash
uv run python infra/chr/test_templates.py [--json results.json]  # dry-run all 4 templates
uv run pytest -m live packages/fixes                             # dry run + approved apply/rollback
```

REST answers on `127.0.0.1:9180` and SSH on `127.0.0.1:9122`. Both are bound to localhost only.

## The router

`baseline.rsc` sets up the router:

| Interface | Role | Address | Gateway |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ether1` | Primary uplink, QEMU user network | DHCP | Static default route via 10.0.2.2 |
| `ether2` | Backup uplink | 192.0.2.2/30 | 192.0.2.1 |
| `ether3` | LAN | 10.0.0.1/24 | — |

It also adds a simple queue for each of subscribers 10.0.0.42 and 10.0.0.57, and sets DNS to
192.0.2.53. `test_templates.py` uses sample params that fit this layout.

## Notes from setting it up (Windows 11 laptop)

- **WHPX:** with WHPX acceleration, RouterOS boots but detects no PCI NICs (virtio or e1000),
  so nothing is reachable. `chr.py` uses TCG (software emulation) on Windows. It's slower,
  but boots in about 30 s, and each template dry run takes about 6 s. On Linux it uses KVM
  when `/dev/kvm` exists.
- **Settling after boot:** RouterOS adds a default `/system keymat-provider` item a little
  after boot. `chr.py` and `test_templates.py` wait until the config stops changing, so
  export diffs stay exact.
- **Errors with HTTP 200:** `/rest/execute` returns many command errors (for example
  `invalid or unexpected argument`) as normal output. `netcortex_fixes.RouterClient` treats
  them as failures.
- **SSH fallback:** every template command runs through REST `/execute`, so no SSH fallback
  was needed.
- **CI:** the partner's `.github/scripts/chr_bootstrap.py` writes `CHR_REST_USERNAME` and
  `CHR_REST_PASSWORD`; `Settings` accepts those names too. CI boots with one NIC and no
  baseline, so in CI `test_templates.py` needs `baseline.rsc` applied first.

"""Rule-based stand-in for packages/detector (TabPFN) until it merges. Same interface:
detect(site_id, window, history) -> DetectionResult, with mode="mock".

It compares the last 3 minutes with the rest of the window and history, and checks the
rules in order: uplink down, DNS slow, heavy user, uplink congestion, upstream degradation.
Forecast bands are the baseline's p10/p50/p90, held flat for the next 5 minutes.
"""

import ipaddress
from datetime import timedelta

import pandas as pd

from netcortex_core import (
    Cause,
    DetectionResult,
    ForecastPoint,
    MetricsWindow,
    ModuleUnavailable,
    SeriesForecast,
    series_key,
)

MODEL = "rules-v0"
RECENT = timedelta(minutes=3)


def _public(target: str) -> bool:
    try:
        return not ipaddress.ip_address(target).is_private
    except ValueError:
        return False


def _split(frame: pd.DataFrame, as_of) -> tuple[pd.DataFrame, pd.DataFrame]:
    if frame.empty:
        return frame, frame
    times = pd.to_datetime(frame["time"], utc=True)
    return frame[times > as_of - RECENT], frame[times <= as_of - RECENT]


def _stat(frame: pd.DataFrame, column: str, name_col: str, name: str, how: str = "median"):
    values = pd.to_numeric(frame.loc[frame[name_col] == name, column], errors="coerce").dropna()
    return None if values.empty else float(getattr(values, how)())


def _forecast(baseline: pd.DataFrame, name_col: str, name: str, column: str, as_of, kind: str):
    values = pd.to_numeric(
        baseline.loc[baseline[name_col] == name, column], errors="coerce"
    ).dropna()
    if len(values) < 3:
        return None
    p10, p50, p90 = (float(values.quantile(q)) for q in (0.1, 0.5, 0.9))
    points = [
        ForecastPoint(time=as_of + timedelta(minutes=m), p10=p10, p50=p50, p90=max(p90, p50))
        for m in range(1, 6)
    ]
    return SeriesForecast(series_key=series_key(kind, name, column), points=points)


def detect(site_id: str, window: MetricsWindow, history: MetricsWindow) -> DetectionResult:
    as_of = window.as_of
    probes = pd.concat([history.probe_metrics, window.probe_metrics], ignore_index=True)
    if window.probe_metrics.empty:
        raise ModuleUnavailable(f"no probe data for {site_id}")
    ifaces = pd.concat([history.iface_metrics, window.iface_metrics], ignore_index=True)
    subs = pd.concat([history.subscriber_metrics, window.subscriber_metrics], ignore_index=True)
    recent_p, base_p = _split(probes, as_of)
    recent_i, base_i = _split(ifaces, as_of)
    recent_s, base_s = _split(subs, as_of)

    icmp_targets = sorted(set(probes.loc[probes["kind"] == "icmp", "target"]))
    public = [t for t in icmp_targets if _public(t)]
    private = [t for t in icmp_targets if not _public(t)]
    dns_targets = sorted(set(probes.loc[probes["kind"] == "dns", "target"]))

    def rtt_ratio(target: str) -> float:
        now = _stat(recent_p, "rtt_ms", "target", target)
        before = _stat(base_p, "rtt_ms", "target", target)
        return (now / before) if now and before else 1.0

    def series(*specs) -> list[SeriesForecast]:
        made = [_forecast(*spec, as_of) for spec in specs]
        return [s for s in made if s is not None]

    cause, evidence, forecasts = Cause.NORMAL, [], []
    loss = {t: _stat(recent_p, "loss_pct", "target", t, "mean") or 0.0 for t in public}

    # 1. Uplink down: outside targets unreachable, gateway fine.
    if public and all(value >= 80 for value in loss.values()):
        gateway_ok = [t for t in private if (_stat(recent_p, "loss_pct", "target", t, "mean") or 0) < 50]
        cause = Cause.UPLINK_DOWN
        evidence.append(f"{min(loss.values()):.0f}% loss to {', '.join(public)} for 3 min")
        if gateway_ok:
            rtt = _stat(recent_p, "rtt_ms", "target", gateway_ok[0]) or 0
            evidence.append(f"gateway {gateway_ok[0]} still answers in {rtt:.0f} ms")
        forecasts = series((base_p, "target", public[0], "loss_pct", "probe"))

    # 2. DNS slow: one resolver slow or failing while pings are normal.
    if cause is Cause.NORMAL:
        for target in dns_targets:
            now = _stat(recent_p, "rtt_ms", "target", target)
            before = _stat(base_p, "rtt_ms", "target", target)
            failing = _stat(recent_p, "loss_pct", "target", target, "mean") or 0
            slow = now is not None and before is not None and now >= max(3 * before, 100)
            if (slow or failing >= 20) and all(rtt_ratio(t) < 2 for t in public):
                cause = Cause.DNS_SLOW
                evidence.append(
                    f"DNS lookups via {target.removeprefix('dns:')} take {now or 0:.0f} ms "
                    f"(normally {before or 0:.0f} ms); {failing:.0f}% fail"
                )
                evidence.append("ping latency to outside targets is normal")
                forecasts = series((base_p, "target", target, "rtt_ms", "probe"))
                break

    # 3. Heavy user: one subscriber far above its usual rate, filling the uplink.
    uplink_util = _stat(recent_i, "util_pct", "iface", "ether1", "mean")
    if cause is Cause.NORMAL and not recent_s.empty:
        total = pd.to_numeric(recent_s["rx_bps"]).sum()
        for ip in sorted(set(recent_s["ip"])):
            now = _stat(recent_s, "rx_bps", "ip", ip, "mean") or 0
            before = _stat(base_s, "rx_bps", "ip", ip) or 0
            share = (pd.to_numeric(recent_s.loc[recent_s["ip"] == ip, "rx_bps"]).sum() / total) if total else 0
            if now >= max(5 * before, 20e6) and share >= 0.3:
                cause = Cause.HEAVY_USER
                evidence.append(f"subscriber {ip} downloading {now / 1e6:.0f} Mbit/s (usually {before / 1e6:.0f})")
                if uplink_util is not None:
                    evidence.append(f"uplink ether1 at {uplink_util:.0f}% for 3 min")
                slow = [t for t in public if rtt_ratio(t) >= 2]
                if slow:
                    evidence.append(f"latency to {slow[0]} up {rtt_ratio(slow[0]):.1f}x")
                forecasts = series(
                    (base_p, "target", (slow or public or icmp_targets)[0], "rtt_ms", "probe"),
                    (base_i, "iface", "ether1", "util_pct", "iface"),
                )
                break

    # 4. Uplink congestion: the uplink is full without one heavy user.
    if cause is Cause.NORMAL and uplink_util is not None and uplink_util >= 90:
        cause = Cause.UPLINK_CONGESTION
        evidence.append(f"uplink ether1 at {uplink_util:.0f}% for 3 min, spread across users")
        forecasts = series((base_i, "iface", "ether1", "util_pct", "iface"))

    # 5. Upstream degradation: every outside target slow, gateway fine.
    if cause is Cause.NORMAL and public and all(rtt_ratio(t) >= 3 for t in public):
        cause = Cause.UPSTREAM_DEGRADATION
        evidence.append(f"latency to {', '.join(public)} up {min(rtt_ratio(t) for t in public):.1f}x; gateway normal")
        forecasts = series((base_p, "target", public[0], "rtt_ms", "probe"))

    anomaly = cause is not Cause.NORMAL
    if not forecasts and public:
        forecasts = series((base_p, "target", public[0], "rtt_ms", "probe"))
    return DetectionResult(
        is_anomaly=anomaly,
        score=0.9 if anomaly else 0.1,
        series=forecasts,
        cause_guess=cause,
        cause_confidence=0.75 if anomaly else 0.9,
        evidence=evidence,
        model=MODEL,
        mode="mock",
    )

"""Minimal stand-in for packages/simgen's inject() until it merges. Same interface:
inject(site_id, scenario_type, duration_min, seed) -> ScenarioLabel.

It writes source=sim rows for the sim site `sim-tower`, whose layout mirrors the CHR
baseline (gateways, subscriber IPs, DNS resolver), so fixes chosen for it apply to CHR:
- 30 minutes of normal data before now (if the site has none yet),
- the incident from now for `duration_min`,
- normal data again for RECOVERY_MIN after that.
Rows dated in the future appear to the monitor as time passes. The recovery is scripted:
CHR carries no real traffic, so a fix there can't change these numbers.
"""

import random
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

from netcortex_core import (
    Cause,
    IfaceMetric,
    ProbeKind,
    ProbeMetric,
    ProbeTarget,
    ScenarioLabel,
    Site,
    Source,
    SubscriberMetric,
    TargetRole,
    TemplateId,
    Uplink,
    UplinkRole,
    db,
)

SIM_SITE = Site(
    id="sim-tower",
    name="Sim Tower (simulated)",
    subscribers=3,
    uplinks=[
        Uplink(iface="ether1", role=UplinkRole.PRIMARY, capacity_mbps=180, gateway="10.0.2.2"),
        Uplink(iface="ether2", role=UplinkRole.BACKUP, capacity_mbps=80, gateway="192.0.2.1"),
    ],
    targets=[
        ProbeTarget(key="10.0.0.1", host="10.0.0.1", role=TargetRole.GATEWAY),
        ProbeTarget(key="1.1.1.1", host="1.1.1.1", role=TargetRole.PUBLIC_DNS),
        ProbeTarget(key="8.8.8.8", host="8.8.8.8", role=TargetRole.PUBLIC_DNS),
        ProbeTarget(
            key="dns:192.0.2.53", host="192.0.2.53", kind=ProbeKind.DNS, role=TargetRole.PUBLIC_DNS
        ),
        ProbeTarget(
            key="dns:1.1.1.1", host="1.1.1.1", kind=ProbeKind.DNS, role=TargetRole.PUBLIC_DNS
        ),
    ],
)

NORMAL_RTT = {"10.0.0.1": 2.0, "1.1.1.1": 18.0, "8.8.8.8": 25.0, "dns:192.0.2.53": 22.0, "dns:1.1.1.1": 12.0}
NORMAL_MBPS = {"10.0.0.42": 4.0, "10.0.0.57": 3.0, "10.0.0.63": 2.5}
CAPACITY_MBPS = {"ether1": 180, "ether2": 80}
BACKFILL_MIN, RECOVERY_MIN = 30, 20

EXPECTED = {
    Cause.HEAVY_USER: (TemplateId.QUEUE_LIMIT, {"target": "10.0.0.42"}, {"ip": "10.0.0.42"}),
    Cause.UPLINK_DOWN: (
        TemplateId.FAILOVER_ROUTE,
        {"primary_gateway": "10.0.2.2", "backup_gateway": "192.0.2.1"},
        {"iface": "ether1"},
    ),
    Cause.DNS_SLOW: (TemplateId.DNS_SERVERS, {}, {"resolver": "192.0.2.53"}),
}


def _rows(start: datetime, end: datetime, cause: Cause | None, rng: random.Random):
    """Probe rows every 10 s, interface and subscriber rows every 30 s."""
    probes, ifaces, subs = [], [], []
    time = start
    while time < end:
        for target, rtt in NORMAL_RTT.items():
            value, loss = rtt * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.15), 0.0
            public = not target.startswith(("10.", "dns:192."))
            if cause is Cause.HEAVY_USER and public and not target.startswith("dns:"):
                value *= 5.5
            elif cause is Cause.UPLINK_DOWN and public:
                value, loss = None, 100.0
            elif cause is Cause.DNS_SLOW and target == "dns:192.0.2.53":
                value, loss = 650 * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.1), 20.0
            probes.append(ProbeMetric(
                time=time, site_id=SIM_SITE.id, target=target,
                kind=ProbeKind.DNS if target.startswith("dns:") else ProbeKind.ICMP,
                rtt_ms=value, jitter_ms=None if value is None else value * 0.08,
                loss_pct=loss, source=Source.SIM,
            ))  # fmt: skip
        if time.second % 30 == 0:
            mbps = dict(NORMAL_MBPS)
            if cause is Cause.HEAVY_USER:
                mbps["10.0.0.42"] = 140.0
            for ip, rate in mbps.items():
                rx = rate * rng.uniform(0.9, 1.1) * 1e6
                subs.append(SubscriberMetric(
                    time=time, site_id=SIM_SITE.id, ip=ip, rx_bps=int(rx), tx_bps=int(rx / 10),
                    source=Source.SIM,
                ))  # fmt: skip
            primary = sum(mbps.values()) + 90  # plus everyone not on a per-IP queue
            if cause is Cause.UPLINK_DOWN:
                primary = 0.0
            for iface, rate in (("ether1", min(primary, 178)), ("ether2", 0.5)):
                bps = int(rate * rng.uniform(0.97, 1.0) * 1e6)
                ifaces.append(IfaceMetric(
                    time=time, site_id=SIM_SITE.id, iface=iface, rx_bps=bps, tx_bps=bps // 8,
                    util_pct=100 * bps / (CAPACITY_MBPS[iface] * 1e6), source=Source.SIM,
                ))  # fmt: skip
        time += timedelta(seconds=10)
    return probes, ifaces, subs


def inject(
    site_id: str, scenario_type: Cause, duration_min: int, seed: int | None
) -> ScenarioLabel:
    scenario_type = Cause(scenario_type)
    if site_id != SIM_SITE.id:
        raise ValueError(f"the stand-in injector only knows site {SIM_SITE.id!r}")
    if scenario_type not in EXPECTED:
        raise ValueError(f"the stand-in injector supports {[c.value for c in EXPECTED]}")
    if not 1 <= duration_min <= 60:
        raise ValueError("duration_min must be between 1 and 60")
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    now = datetime.now(UTC).replace(microsecond=0)
    now -= timedelta(seconds=now.second % 10)
    incident_end = now + timedelta(minutes=duration_min)
    template, params, affected = EXPECTED[scenario_type]
    label = ScenarioLabel(
        site_id=SIM_SITE.id, scenario_type=scenario_type, start_at=now, end_at=incident_end,
        affected=affected, expected_cause=scenario_type, expected_template=template,
        expected_params=params, seed=seed, source=Source.SIM,
    )  # fmt: skip

    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        with conn.cursor() as cur:
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT max(time) FROM probe_metrics WHERE site_id = %s AND source = 'sim'",
                (SIM_SITE.id,),
            )
            last = cur.fetchone()[0]
            cur.execute(
                "SELECT 1 FROM scenario_labels WHERE site_id = %s AND end_at > %s",
                (SIM_SITE.id, now),
            )
            if cur.fetchone():
                raise ValueError(f"an injected scenario is still running on {SIM_SITE.id}")
        db.upsert_site(conn, SIM_SITE)
        # Normal data up to now (only what's missing), the incident, then recovery.
        start = max(last + timedelta(seconds=10), now - timedelta(minutes=BACKFILL_MIN)) if last else now - timedelta(minutes=BACKFILL_MIN)
        if last and last > now:  # earlier recovery rows reach into the future: replace them
            with conn.cursor() as cur:
                for table in ("probe_metrics", "iface_metrics", "subscriber_metrics"):
                    cur.execute(f"DELETE FROM {table} WHERE site_id = %s AND time >= %s", (SIM_SITE.id, now))
            start = now
        for begin, end, cause in (
            (start, now, None),
            (now, incident_end, scenario_type),
            (incident_end, incident_end + timedelta(minutes=RECOVERY_MIN), None),
        ):
            if begin >= end:
                continue
            probes, ifaces, subs = _rows(begin, end, cause, rng)
            db.insert_probe_metrics(conn, probes)
            db.insert_iface_metrics(conn, ifaces)
            db.insert_subscriber_metrics(conn, subs)
        db.insert_scenario_label(conn, label)
    return label

import random
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta

import pandas as pd
import pytest
from netcortex_agent import stub_injector
from netcortex_agent.stub_detector import detect
from netcortex_core import (
    IFACE_COLUMNS,
    PROBE_COLUMNS,
    SUBSCRIBER_COLUMNS,
    Cause,
    Detect,
    Inject,
    MetricsWindow,
    conforms,
)

AS_OF = datetime(2026, 10, 18, 15, 0, tzinfo=UTC)


def window_for(cause: Cause | None, incident_min: int = 4) -> MetricsWindow:
    """30 minutes from the injector's generator: normal, then `incident_min` of `cause`."""
    rng = random.Random(7)
    start, split = AS_OF - timedelta(minutes=30), AS_OF - timedelta(minutes=incident_min)
    parts = [stub_injector._rows(start, split, None, rng), stub_injector._rows(split, AS_OF, cause, rng)]
    frames = []
    for i, columns in enumerate((PROBE_COLUMNS, IFACE_COLUMNS, SUBSCRIBER_COLUMNS)):
        rows = [row.model_dump() for part in parts for row in part[i]]
        frames.append(pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=list(columns)))
    return MetricsWindow(
        as_of=AS_OF, probe_metrics=frames[0], iface_metrics=frames[1], subscriber_metrics=frames[2]
    )


def test_stand_ins_match_the_shared_interfaces():
    assert conforms(detect, Detect)
    assert conforms(stub_injector.inject, Inject)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("cause", "evidence"),
    [
        (Cause.HEAVY_USER, "subscriber 10.0.0.42 downloading"),
        (Cause.UPLINK_DOWN, "100% loss to 1.1.1.1, 8.8.8.8"),
        (Cause.DNS_SLOW, "DNS lookups via 192.0.2.53"),
    ],
)
def test_detector_names_each_injected_scenario(cause, evidence):
    result = detect("sim-tower", window_for(cause), MetricsWindow(as_of=AS_OF))
    assert result.is_anomaly and result.cause_guess is cause and result.mode == "mock"
    assert any(evidence in line for line in result.evidence), result.evidence
    assert result.series and len(result.series[0].points) == 5


def test_normal_data_is_not_an_anomaly():
    result = detect("sim-tower", window_for(None), MetricsWindow(as_of=AS_OF))
    assert not result.is_anomaly and result.cause_guess is Cause.NORMAL


def test_detector_series_match_the_fix_templates_verify_metric():
    keys = {
        cause: [s.series_key for s in detect("sim-tower", window_for(cause), MetricsWindow(as_of=AS_OF)).series]
        for cause in (Cause.HEAVY_USER, Cause.UPLINK_DOWN, Cause.DNS_SLOW)
    }
    assert any(k.endswith(":rtt_ms") for k in keys[Cause.HEAVY_USER])
    assert keys[Cause.UPLINK_DOWN][0].endswith(":loss_pct")
    assert keys[Cause.DNS_SLOW][0] == "probe:dns:192.0.2.53:rtt_ms"


def test_injector_rejects_unknown_sites_and_scenarios():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="only knows site"):
        stub_injector.inject("north-tower", Cause.HEAVY_USER, 5, 1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="supports"):
        stub_injector.inject("sim-tower", Cause.WIRELESS_INTERFERENCE, 5, 1)

"""Temporal activities: everything that touches the database, the detector or CHR.

Workflows stay deterministic; all I/O happens here. Each activity runs its blocking work in
a thread (asyncio.to_thread keeps the Sentry trace context) and writes an `events` row
whenever an incident's state changes.
"""

import asyncio
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import UUID

import netcortex_fixes as fixes
import pandas as pd
import sentry_sdk
from netcortex_agent import facts, modules
from netcortex_agent.agent import Deps
from netcortex_core import (
    DetectionResult,
    EventKind,
    FixPlan,
    Incident,
    IncidentReport,
    IncidentStatus,
    Source,
    TemplateId,
    db,
    parse_series_key,
)
from psycopg.errors import UniqueViolation
from pydantic import BaseModel
from temporalio import activity

WINDOW = timedelta(minutes=30)
HISTORY = timedelta(hours=2)  # baseline for the detector; more is slow at 10 s resolution
STALE_AFTER = timedelta(minutes=2)
VERIFY_BEFORE = timedelta(minutes=3)  # metric before the incident opened ...
VERIFY_AFTER = timedelta(minutes=2)  # ... against the last minutes of the watch period


class MonitorResult(BaseModel):
    site_id: str
    status: Literal["skipped", "normal", "already_open", "opened"]
    reason: str = ""
    incident_id: UUID | None = None
    opened_at: datetime | None = None
    prompt: str = ""
    deps: Deps | None = None


class VerifyResult(BaseModel):
    improved: bool
    detail: str


def _event(conn, kind: EventKind, incident_id: UUID, site_id: str, **payload: Any) -> None:
    db.insert_event(
        conn, kind, {"incident_id": str(incident_id), "site_id": site_id, **payload}
    )


# --- Monitoring -----------------------------------------------------------------------


def _monitor(site_id: str) -> MonitorResult:
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        window = db.fetch_window(conn, site_id, now - WINDOW, now)
        history = db.fetch_window(conn, site_id, now - WINDOW - HISTORY, now - WINDOW)
    probes = window.probe_metrics
    if probes.empty:
        return MonitorResult(site_id=site_id, status="skipped", reason="no data")
    newest = pd.to_datetime(probes["time"], utc=True).max()
    if newest < now - STALE_AFTER:
        return MonitorResult(site_id=site_id, status="skipped", reason=f"stale since {newest}")

    with sentry_sdk.start_span(op="netcortex.detect", name=f"detect {site_id}") as span:
        try:
            detection = modules.detect(site_id, window, history)
        except Exception as exc:  # a failed detector never stops monitoring
            span.set_status("internal_error")
            return MonitorResult(
                site_id=site_id, status="skipped", reason=f"detector: {type(exc).__name__}"
            )
        span.set_data("cause_guess", detection.cause_guess.value)
        span.set_data("is_anomaly", detection.is_anomaly)

    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        db.upsert_forecasts(conn, site_id, detection)
        if not detection.is_anomaly:
            return MonitorResult(site_id=site_id, status="normal")
        if db.has_open_incident(conn, site_id, detection.cause_guess.value):
            return MonitorResult(site_id=site_id, status="already_open")
        incident = Incident(
            site_id=site_id,
            opened_at=now,
            cause=detection.cause_guess,
            confidence=detection.cause_confidence,
            detection=detection,
            source=Source(str(probes["source"].iloc[-1])),
        )
        try:
            db.insert_incident(conn, incident)
        except UniqueViolation:
            return MonitorResult(site_id=site_id, status="already_open")
        _event(conn, EventKind.INCIDENT_OPENED, incident.id, site_id,
               status="open", cause=detection.cause_guess.value)  # fmt: skip
        site = db.fetch_site(conn, site_id)
    return MonitorResult(
        site_id=site_id,
        status="opened",
        incident_id=incident.id,
        opened_at=now,
        prompt=facts.build_prompt(site_id, site, detection, window),
        deps=Deps.build(site_id, detection, window, site),
    )


@activity.defn
async def monitor_site(site_id: str) -> MonitorResult:
    """Load the last 30 minutes, run detect(), store forecasts, open an incident if needed."""
    return await asyncio.to_thread(_monitor, site_id)


# --- Incident steps -------------------------------------------------------------------


def _save_report(incident_id: UUID, site_id: str, report: IncidentReport) -> None:
    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        db.save_report(conn, incident_id, report)
        _event(conn, EventKind.INCIDENT_UPDATED, incident_id, site_id, status="open",
               note=f"report: {report.likely_cause.value} -> {report.template_id.value}")  # fmt: skip


@activity.defn
async def save_report(incident_id: UUID, site_id: str, report: IncidentReport) -> None:
    await asyncio.to_thread(_save_report, incident_id, site_id, report)


def _check_fix(incident_id: UUID, site_id: str, template_id: TemplateId, params: dict) -> FixPlan:
    with sentry_sdk.start_span(op="netcortex.check_fix", name=f"dry run {template_id.value}"):
        plan = fixes.check_fix(incident_id, template_id, params)
    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        _event(conn, EventKind.FIX_TESTED, incident_id, site_id,
               fix_plan_id=str(plan.id), dry_run_ok=plan.dry_run_ok)  # fmt: skip
    return plan


@activity.defn
async def check_fix(
    incident_id: UUID, site_id: str, template_id: TemplateId, params: dict
) -> FixPlan:
    """Dry-run the proposed fix on CHR and store it in fix_plans."""
    return await asyncio.to_thread(_check_fix, incident_id, site_id, template_id, params)


def _set_status(incident_id: UUID, site_id: str, status: IncidentStatus, note: str) -> None:
    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        db.set_incident_status(conn, incident_id, status)
        _event(conn, EventKind.INCIDENT_UPDATED, incident_id, site_id,
               status=status.value, note=note)  # fmt: skip


@activity.defn
async def set_status(
    incident_id: UUID, site_id: str, status: IncidentStatus, note: str = ""
) -> None:
    await asyncio.to_thread(_set_status, incident_id, site_id, status, note)


def _record_decision(fix_plan_id: UUID, decision: str, decided_by: str) -> None:
    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        db.set_fix_decision(conn, fix_plan_id, decision, decided_by)


@activity.defn
async def record_decision(fix_plan_id: UUID, decision: str, decided_by: str) -> None:
    await asyncio.to_thread(_record_decision, fix_plan_id, decision, decided_by)


def _apply(plan: FixPlan, site_id: str) -> str:
    with sentry_sdk.start_span(op="netcortex.apply", name=f"apply {plan.template_id.value}"):
        output = fixes.apply(plan)
    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        _event(conn, EventKind.FIX_APPLIED, plan.incident_id, site_id,
               fix_plan_id=str(plan.id), template_id=plan.template_id.value)  # fmt: skip
    return output


@activity.defn
async def apply_fix(plan: FixPlan, site_id: str) -> str:
    """Apply an approved fix to CHR (never a real router)."""
    return await asyncio.to_thread(_apply, plan, site_id)


@activity.defn
async def rollback_fix(plan: FixPlan) -> str:
    with sentry_sdk.start_span(op="netcortex.rollback", name=f"rollback {plan.template_id.value}"):
        return await asyncio.to_thread(fixes.rollback, plan)


def _mean(window, key: str, start: datetime, end: datetime) -> float | None:
    kind, name, metric = parse_series_key(key)
    frame, column = {
        "probe": (window.probe_metrics, "target"),
        "iface": (window.iface_metrics, "iface"),
        "subscriber": (window.subscriber_metrics, "ip"),
    }[kind]
    if frame.empty:
        return None
    times = pd.to_datetime(frame["time"], utc=True)
    rows = frame[(frame[column] == name) & (times > start) & (times <= end)]
    values = pd.to_numeric(rows[metric], errors="coerce").dropna()
    return None if values.empty else float(values.mean())


def _verify(
    site_id: str, detection: DetectionResult, template_id: TemplateId, opened_at: datetime
) -> VerifyResult:
    spec = fixes.get_template(template_id).verify
    if spec is None:
        return VerifyResult(improved=True, detail="nothing to verify")
    keys = [s.series_key for s in detection.series if s.series_key.endswith(f":{spec.metric}")]
    if not keys:
        return VerifyResult(improved=False, detail=f"no {spec.metric} series in the detection")
    now = datetime.now(UTC)
    with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
        window = db.fetch_window(conn, site_id, opened_at - VERIFY_BEFORE, now)
    details, improved = [], True
    for key in keys:
        before = _mean(window, key, opened_at - VERIFY_BEFORE, opened_at)
        after = _mean(window, key, now - VERIFY_AFTER, now)
        if before is None or after is None:
            details.append(f"{key}: not enough data")
            improved = False
            continue
        target = before * (1 - spec.by_pct / 100) if spec.goal == "decrease" else before * (1 + spec.by_pct / 100)
        ok = after <= target if spec.goal == "decrease" else after >= target
        improved = improved and ok
        details.append(f"{key}: {before:.1f} -> {after:.1f} (needed {spec.goal} by {spec.by_pct:g}%)")
    return VerifyResult(improved=improved, detail="; ".join(details))


@activity.defn
async def verify_fix(
    site_id: str, detection: DetectionResult, template_id: TemplateId, opened_at: datetime
) -> VerifyResult:
    """Did the key metric improve by the template's verify rule after the fix?"""
    return await asyncio.to_thread(_verify, site_id, detection, template_id, opened_at)


ALL = [
    monitor_site,
    save_report,
    check_fix,
    set_status,
    record_decision,
    apply_fix,
    rollback_fix,
    verify_fix,
]

"""The incident agent wrapped for Temporal: each model request and tool call is an activity,
so a worker crash mid-investigation resumes where it stopped instead of starting over."""

from datetime import timedelta

from netcortex_agent.agent import MODEL_TIMEOUT_S, build_model, incident_agent, model_settings
from netcortex_core import get_settings
from pydantic_ai.durable_exec.temporal import TemporalAgent
from temporalio.common import RetryPolicy
from temporalio.workflow import ActivityConfig

temporal_agent = TemporalAgent(
    incident_agent,
    models={"gemma": build_model(get_settings())},
    activity_config=ActivityConfig(
        start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(seconds=60),
        retry_policy=RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=3),
    ),
    model_activity_config=ActivityConfig(
        start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(seconds=MODEL_TIMEOUT_S + 30),
        retry_policy=RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=3, initial_interval=timedelta(seconds=5)),
    ),
)

AGENT_SETTINGS = model_settings(thinking=False)

"""MonitorSiteWorkflow (one per site) and IncidentWorkflow (one per incident).

Incident flow: investigate (TemporalAgent) -> dry run on CHR -> awaiting_approval ->
approve/reject signal (or time out) -> apply on CHR -> watch -> verify -> resolved, or
roll back -> rolled_back. A failed partner or model call never kills a workflow: the
incident falls back to a notify-only report instead.
"""

from datetime import datetime, timedelta
from uuid import UUID

from pydantic import BaseModel
from temporalio import workflow
from temporalio.common import RetryPolicy
from temporalio.exceptions import ActivityError
from temporalio.workflow import ParentClosePolicy

with workflow.unsafe.imports_passed_through():
    from netcortex_agent.agent import Deps, fallback_report, with_news
    from netcortex_core import FixPlan, IncidentReport, IncidentStatus, TemplateId
    from pydantic_ai.durable_exec.temporal import PydanticAIWorkflow

    from netcortex_worker import activities as act
    from netcortex_worker.durable import AGENT_SETTINGS, temporal_agent

RETRY = RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=3, initial_interval=timedelta(seconds=2))
SHORT = timedelta(seconds=60)


class Timing(BaseModel):
    monitor_interval_s: float = 60
    approval_timeout_s: float = 7200
    verify_wait_s: float = 300


class MonitorInput(BaseModel):
    site_id: str
    timing: Timing = Timing()
    rounds_before_continue: int = 60


class IncidentInput(BaseModel):
    incident_id: UUID
    site_id: str
    opened_at: datetime
    prompt: str
    deps: Deps
    timing: Timing = Timing()


@workflow.defn
class MonitorSiteWorkflow:
    @workflow.run
    async def run(self, inp: MonitorInput) -> None:
        for _ in range(inp.rounds_before_continue):
            try:
                result = await workflow.execute_activity(
                    act.monitor_site,
                    inp.site_id,
                    start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(seconds=120),
                    retry_policy=RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=2),
                )
            except ActivityError as exc:
                workflow.logger.warning("monitor round failed for %s: %s", inp.site_id, exc)
                result = None
            if result is not None and result.status == "opened":
                await workflow.start_child_workflow(
                    IncidentWorkflow.run,
                    IncidentInput(
                        incident_id=result.incident_id,
                        site_id=inp.site_id,
                        opened_at=result.opened_at,
                        prompt=result.prompt,
                        deps=result.deps,
                        timing=inp.timing,
                    ),
                    id=f"incident-{result.incident_id}",
                    parent_close_policy=ParentClosePolicy.ABANDON,
                )
            await workflow.sleep(timedelta(seconds=inp.timing.monitor_interval_s))
        workflow.continue_as_new(inp)


@workflow.defn
class IncidentWorkflow(PydanticAIWorkflow):
    __pydantic_ai_agents__ = [temporal_agent]

    def __init__(self) -> None:
        self.status = IncidentStatus.OPEN
        self.decision: str | None = None
        self.decided_by = ""

    @workflow.signal
    def approve(self, decided_by: str) -> None:
        if self.status is IncidentStatus.AWAITING_APPROVAL and self.decision is None:
            self.decision, self.decided_by = "approved", decided_by

    @workflow.signal
    def reject(self, decided_by: str) -> None:
        if self.status is IncidentStatus.AWAITING_APPROVAL and self.decision is None:
            self.decision, self.decided_by = "rejected", decided_by

    @workflow.query
    def current_status(self) -> str:
        return self.status.value

    async def _status(self, inp: IncidentInput, status: IncidentStatus, note: str = "") -> None:
        self.status = status
        await workflow.execute_activity(
            act.set_status, args=[inp.incident_id, inp.site_id, status, note],
            start_to_close_timeout=SHORT, retry_policy=RETRY,
        )  # fmt: skip

    async def _investigate(self, inp: IncidentInput) -> IncidentReport:
        try:
            result = await temporal_agent.run(
                inp.prompt, deps=inp.deps, model_settings=AGENT_SETTINGS
            )
            return with_news(result.output, result.all_messages())
        except Exception as exc:  # model down or invalid twice: notify-only report
            workflow.logger.warning("investigation failed, using template none: %s", exc)
            return fallback_report(inp.deps.detection)

    @workflow.run
    async def run(self, inp: IncidentInput) -> str:
        # 1. Investigate.
        report = await self._investigate(inp)
        await workflow.execute_activity(
            act.save_report, args=[inp.incident_id, inp.site_id, report],
            start_to_close_timeout=SHORT, retry_policy=RETRY,
        )  # fmt: skip

        # 2. Dry-run the fix on CHR.
        plan: FixPlan | None = None
        if report.template_id is not TemplateId.NONE:
            try:
                plan = await workflow.execute_activity(
                    act.check_fix,
                    args=[inp.incident_id, inp.site_id, report.template_id, report.template_params],
                    start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(seconds=180), retry_policy=RETRY,
                )  # fmt: skip
            except ActivityError as exc:
                workflow.logger.warning("dry run could not run: %s", exc)
            if plan is None or not plan.dry_run_ok:
                await self._status(inp, IncidentStatus.REJECTED, "fix did not pass its CHR dry run")
                return self.status.value

        # 3. Wait for the owner.
        await self._status(inp, IncidentStatus.AWAITING_APPROVAL)
        try:
            await workflow.wait_condition(
                lambda: self.decision is not None,
                timeout=timedelta(seconds=inp.timing.approval_timeout_s),
            )
        except TimeoutError:
            self.decision, self.decided_by = "rejected", "timeout"
        if plan is not None:
            await workflow.execute_activity(
                act.record_decision, args=[plan.id, self.decision, self.decided_by],
                start_to_close_timeout=SHORT, retry_policy=RETRY,
            )  # fmt: skip
        if self.decision != "approved":
            await self._status(inp, IncidentStatus.REJECTED, f"rejected by {self.decided_by}")
            return self.status.value
        if plan is None:
            await self._status(inp, IncidentStatus.RESOLVED, "acknowledged; no router change")
            return self.status.value

        # 4. Apply, watch, verify.
        approved = plan.model_copy(update={"decision": "approved", "decided_by": self.decided_by})
        await self._status(inp, IncidentStatus.APPLYING)
        try:
            await workflow.execute_activity(
                act.apply_fix, args=[approved, inp.site_id],
                start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(seconds=120), retry_policy=RetryPolicy(maximum_attempts=1),
            )  # fmt: skip
        except ActivityError as exc:
            await self._rollback(inp, approved, f"apply failed: {exc.cause or exc}")
            return self.status.value
        await self._status(inp, IncidentStatus.VERIFYING, f"watching for {inp.timing.verify_wait_s:.0f} s")
        await workflow.sleep(timedelta(seconds=inp.timing.verify_wait_s))
        verdict = await workflow.execute_activity(
            act.verify_fix,
            args=[inp.site_id, inp.deps.detection, report.template_id, inp.opened_at],
            start_to_close_timeout=SHORT, retry_policy=RETRY,
        )  # fmt: skip
        if verdict.improved:
            await self._status(inp, IncidentStatus.RESOLVED, verdict.detail)
        else:
            await self._rollback(inp, approved, f"not improved: {verdict.detail}")
        return self.status.value

    async def _rollback(self, inp: IncidentInput, plan: FixPlan, reason: str) -> None:
        try:
            await workflow.execute_activity(
                act.rollback_fix, plan, start_to_close_timeout=timedelta(seconds=120),
                retry_policy=RETRY,
            )  # fmt: skip
        except ActivityError as exc:
            reason += f"; rollback failed: {exc.cause or exc}"
        await self._status(inp, IncidentStatus.ROLLED_BACK, reason)

"""`uv run worker`: the Temporal worker, plus one MonitorSiteWorkflow per MONITOR_SITES site.

Sentry: every activity runs in a transaction. Activities of incident workflows share one
trace whose ID is the incident ID, so a whole incident (model calls, tool calls, dry run,
apply, verify) shows up as a single trace.
"""

import argparse
import asyncio
import logging
import secrets
from dataclasses import replace
from typing import Any
from uuid import UUID

import netcortex_fixes as fixes
import sentry_sdk
from netcortex_core import get_settings
from netcortex_core.tracing import init_sentry
from pydantic_ai.durable_exec.temporal import PydanticAIPlugin
from temporalio import activity
from temporalio.client import Client
from temporalio.common import WorkflowIDConflictPolicy
from temporalio.worker import (
    ActivityInboundInterceptor,
    ExecuteActivityInput,
    Interceptor,
    Worker,
)
from temporalio.worker.workflow_sandbox import SandboxedWorkflowRunner, SandboxRestrictions

from netcortex_worker import activities
from netcortex_worker.workflows import IncidentWorkflow, MonitorInput, MonitorSiteWorkflow, Timing

log = logging.getLogger("worker")

# Modules the workflow sandbox may share with the worker process instead of re-importing.
PASSTHROUGH = (
    "netcortex_core", "netcortex_agent", "netcortex_fixes", "pandas", "numpy", "sentry_sdk",
    "openai", "psycopg", "psycopg_pool", "yaml", "jinja2", "markupsafe", "dateutil", "tzdata",
)  # fmt: skip


def trace_id_for(workflow_id: str) -> str | None:
    """incident-<uuid> -> the uuid's 32 hex digits, used as the Sentry trace ID."""
    if not workflow_id.startswith("incident-"):
        return None
    try:
        return UUID(workflow_id.removeprefix("incident-")).hex
    except ValueError:
        return None


class _SentryActivities(ActivityInboundInterceptor):
    async def execute_activity(self, input: ExecuteActivityInput) -> Any:
        info = activity.info()
        trace_id = trace_id_for(info.workflow_id)
        headers = {"sentry-trace": f"{trace_id}-{secrets.token_hex(8)}-1"} if trace_id else {}
        transaction = sentry_sdk.continue_trace(
            headers, op="temporal.activity", name=info.activity_type
        )
        with sentry_sdk.start_transaction(transaction):
            sentry_sdk.set_tag("workflow_id", info.workflow_id)
            sentry_sdk.set_tag("activity", info.activity_type)
            return await self.next.execute_activity(input)


class SentryInterceptor(Interceptor):
    def intercept_activity(self, next: ActivityInboundInterceptor) -> ActivityInboundInterceptor:
        return _SentryActivities(next)


async def start_monitors(client: Client, sites: list[str], timing: Timing, queue: str) -> None:
    for site_id in sites:
        await client.start_workflow(
            MonitorSiteWorkflow.run,
            MonitorInput(site_id=site_id, timing=timing),
            id=f"monitor-{site_id}",
            task_queue=queue,
            id_conflict_policy=WorkflowIDConflictPolicy.USE_EXISTING,
        )
        log.info("monitoring %s", site_id)


async def run() -> None:
    settings = get_settings()
    init_sentry("worker", settings)
    fixes.load_templates()  # read the YAML once, outside the workflow sandbox
    client = await Client.connect(settings.temporal_address, plugins=[PydanticAIPlugin()])
    timing = Timing(
        monitor_interval_s=settings.monitor_interval_s,
        approval_timeout_s=settings.approval_timeout_s,
        verify_wait_s=settings.verify_wait_s,
    )
    runner = SandboxedWorkflowRunner()
    runner = replace(
        runner, restrictions=SandboxRestrictions.default.with_passthrough_modules(*PASSTHROUGH)
    )
    worker = Worker(
        client,
        task_queue=settings.temporal_task_queue,
        workflows=[MonitorSiteWorkflow, IncidentWorkflow],
        activities=activities.ALL,
        workflow_runner=runner,
        interceptors=[SentryInterceptor()],
    )
    await start_monitors(client, settings.monitor_sites, timing, settings.temporal_task_queue)
    log.info("worker running on task queue %s", settings.temporal_task_queue)
    await worker.run()


def main() -> int:
    argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="worker", description=__doc__.splitlines()[0]).parse_args()
    logging.basicConfig(level=logging.INFO, format="%(asctime)s %(levelname)s %(name)s %(message)s")
    logging.getLogger("httpx").setLevel(logging.WARNING)
    try:
        asyncio.run(run())
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        pass
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())

"""Where the API reads from: the live database, or a saved snapshot in DEMO_MODE."""

import json
from datetime import UTC, datetime, timedelta
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any, Literal
from uuid import UUID

from netcortex_core import (
    Event,
    FixPlan,
    Incident,
    IncidentStatus,
    db,
    parse_series_key,
)
from pydantic import BaseModel

SNAPSHOT = Path(__file__).with_name("demo") / "snapshot.json"
Health = Literal["ok", "degraded", "down", "unknown"]


class SiteHealth(BaseModel):
    id: str
    name: str
    health: Health
    worst_rtt_ms: float | None = None
    max_loss_pct: float | None = None
    uplink_util_pct: float | None = None
    open_incidents: int = 0
    updated_at: datetime | None = None
    uplinks: list[dict[str, Any]] = []


class Point(BaseModel):
    time: datetime
    value: float | None


class Band(BaseModel):
    time: datetime
    p10: float
    p50: float
    p90: float


class Series(BaseModel):
    series_key: str
    points: list[Point]
    forecast: list[Band]


class IncidentSummary(BaseModel):
    id: UUID
    site_id: str
    opened_at: datetime
    closed_at: datetime | None
    status: IncidentStatus
    cause: str
    confidence: float | None
    summary: str | None = None
    template_id: str | None = None


class IncidentDetail(BaseModel):
    incident: Incident
    fix_plan: FixPlan | None
    timeline: list[Event]


def summarize(incident: Incident) -> IncidentSummary:
    return IncidentSummary(
        **incident.model_dump(include={"id", "site_id", "opened_at", "closed_at", "status",
                                       "confidence"}),
        cause=incident.cause.value,
        summary=incident.report.summary if incident.report else None,
        template_id=incident.report.template_id.value if incident.report else None,
    )  # fmt: skip


def health_of(rows: list[tuple], open_incidents: int) -> Health:
    """rows: (target, rtt_ms, loss_pct) from the last two minutes."""
    if not rows:
        return "unknown"
    public = [r for r in rows if not r[0].startswith(("10.", "192.168.", "172.", "dns:"))]
    if public and all((r[2] or 0) >= 80 for r in public):
        return "down"
    if open_incidents or any((r[2] or 0) >= 10 for r in rows):
        return "degraded"
    return "ok"


class LiveStore:
    """Reads Tiger Cloud."""

    def sites(self) -> list[SiteHealth]:
        now = datetime.now(UTC)
        out = []
        with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
            sites = conn.execute("SELECT id, name, uplinks FROM sites ORDER BY id").fetchall()
            for site_id, name, uplinks in sites:
                rows = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT DISTINCT ON (target) target, rtt_ms, loss_pct, time FROM probe_metrics "
                    "WHERE site_id = %s AND time > %s AND time <= %s ORDER BY target, time DESC",
                    (site_id, now - timedelta(minutes=2), now),
                ).fetchall()
                util = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT util_pct FROM iface_metrics WHERE site_id = %s AND iface = 'ether1' "
                    "AND time <= %s ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1",
                    (site_id, now),
                ).fetchone()
                open_count = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT count(*) FROM incidents WHERE site_id = %s AND closed_at IS NULL",
                    (site_id,),
                ).fetchone()[0]
                rtts = [r[1] for r in rows if r[1] is not None]
                out.append(SiteHealth(
                    id=site_id, name=name, health=health_of(rows, open_count),
                    worst_rtt_ms=max(rtts) if rtts else None,
                    max_loss_pct=max((r[2] for r in rows), default=None),
                    uplink_util_pct=util[0] if util else None, open_incidents=open_count,
                    updated_at=max((r[3] for r in rows), default=None), uplinks=uplinks,
                ))  # fmt: skip
        return out

    def metrics(self, site_id: str, start: datetime, end: datetime, keys: list[str]) -> list[Series]:
        out = []
        with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
            for key in keys:
                kind, name, metric = parse_series_key(key)
                table, column = {
                    "probe": ("probe_metrics", "target"),
                    "iface": ("iface_metrics", "iface"),
                    "subscriber": ("subscriber_metrics", "ip"),
                }[kind]
                if metric not in {"rtt_ms", "jitter_ms", "loss_pct", "util_pct", "rx_bps",
                                  "tx_bps", "drops", "errors"}:  # fmt: skip
                    raise ValueError(f"unknown metric {metric!r}")
                points = conn.execute(
                    f"SELECT time, {metric} FROM {table} WHERE site_id = %s AND {column} = %s "
                    "AND time > %s AND time <= %s ORDER BY time",
                    (site_id, name, start, min(end, datetime.now(UTC))),
                ).fetchall()
                bands = conn.execute(
                    "SELECT DISTINCT ON (time) time, p10, p50, p90 FROM forecasts "
                    "WHERE site_id = %s AND series_key = %s AND time > %s AND time <= %s "
                    "ORDER BY time",
                    (site_id, key, start, end + timedelta(minutes=5)),
                ).fetchall()
                out.append(Series(
                    series_key=key,
                    points=[Point(time=t, value=v) for t, v in points],
                    forecast=[Band(time=t, p10=a, p50=b, p90=c) for t, a, b, c in bands],
                ))  # fmt: skip
        return out

    def incidents(self, status: IncidentStatus | None) -> list[IncidentSummary]:
        columns = tuple(Incident.model_fields)
        query = f"SELECT {', '.join(columns)} FROM incidents"
        params: tuple = ()
        if status:
            query, params = query + " WHERE status = %s", (status.value,)
        with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
            rows = conn.execute(query + " ORDER BY opened_at DESC LIMIT 200", params).fetchall()
        return [summarize(Incident.model_validate(dict(zip(columns, r, strict=True)))) for r in rows]

    def incident(self, incident_id: UUID) -> IncidentDetail | None:
        with db.get_pool().connection() as conn:
            incident = db.fetch_incident(conn, incident_id)
            if incident is None:
                return None
            plan = db.latest_fix_plan(conn, incident_id)
            rows = conn.execute(
                "SELECT id, time, kind, payload FROM events WHERE payload->>'incident_id' = %s "
                "ORDER BY id",
                (str(incident_id),),
            ).fetchall()
        timeline = [Event(id=i, time=t, kind=k, payload=p) for i, t, k, p in rows]
        return IncidentDetail(incident=incident, fix_plan=plan, timeline=timeline)


class DemoStore:
    """Serves a snapshot of real runs (services/api/.../demo/snapshot.json). No database,
    no model, no router: approvals only move the saved incident forward in memory."""

    def __init__(self, path: Path = SNAPSHOT) -> None:
        data = json.loads(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if path.exists() else {}
        self._sites = [SiteHealth.model_validate(s) for s in data.get("sites", [])]
        self._series = {s["series_key"]: Series.model_validate(s) for s in data.get("series", [])}
        self._incidents = {
            UUID(d["incident"]["id"]): IncidentDetail.model_validate(d)
            for d in data.get("incidents", [])
        }

    def sites(self) -> list[SiteHealth]:
        return self._sites

    def metrics(self, site_id: str, start: datetime, end: datetime, keys: list[str]) -> list[Series]:
        return [self._series[k] for k in keys if k in self._series]

    def incidents(self, status: IncidentStatus | None) -> list[IncidentSummary]:
        found = [summarize(d.incident) for d in self._incidents.values()]
        found = [i for i in found if status is None or i.status is status]
        return sorted(found, key=lambda i: i.opened_at, reverse=True)

    def incident(self, incident_id: UUID) -> IncidentDetail | None:
        return self._incidents.get(incident_id)

    def decide(self, incident_id: UUID, decision: str) -> None:
        detail = self._incidents[incident_id]
        status = IncidentStatus.RESOLVED if decision == "approved" else IncidentStatus.REJECTED
        detail.incident.status = status
        detail.incident.closed_at = datetime.now(UTC)

"""End-to-end run through the API, like the dashboard would do it.

    uv run python infra/scripts/e2e.py heavy_user [--api http://127.0.0.1:8000] [--reject]

Injects a scenario on sim-tower, waits for the incident, shows the agent's report and the
CHR dry run, approves (or rejects), waits for the final status and prints the timeline.
Needs the worker, Temporal, CHR and the API running.
"""

import argparse
import sys
import time
from datetime import datetime

import httpx

FINAL = {"resolved", "rolled_back", "rejected"}


def wait_for(fetch, done, timeout_s: float, every_s: float = 3):
    deadline = time.monotonic() + timeout_s
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        value = fetch()
        if done(value):
            return value
        time.sleep(every_s)
    raise TimeoutError("gave up waiting")


def main() -> int:
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("scenario", choices=["heavy_user", "uplink_down", "dns_slow"])
    parser.add_argument("--api", default="http://127.0.0.1:8000")
    parser.add_argument("--duration", type=int, default=5)
    parser.add_argument("--reject", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    api = httpx.Client(base_url=args.api, timeout=30)

    known = {i["id"] for i in api.get("/incidents").json()}
    started = time.monotonic()
    label = api.post(
        "/demo/scenarios",
        json={"site_id": "sim-tower", "scenario_type": args.scenario, "duration_min": args.duration},
    )
    if label.status_code != 201:
        print(f"inject failed: {label.status_code} {label.text}")
        return 1
    print(f"[{0:6.1f}s] injected {args.scenario} on sim-tower")

    def new_incident():
        found = [i for i in api.get("/incidents").json() if i["id"] not in known]
        return found[0] if found else None

    incident = wait_for(new_incident, bool, timeout_s=300)
    incident_id = incident["id"]
    print(f"[{time.monotonic() - started:6.1f}s] incident {incident_id} opened: {incident['cause']}")

    detail = wait_for(
        lambda: api.get(f"/incidents/{incident_id}").json(),
        lambda d: d["incident"]["status"] != "open",
        timeout_s=600,
    )
    report, plan = detail["incident"]["report"], detail["fix_plan"]
    print(f"[{time.monotonic() - started:6.1f}s] status {detail['incident']['status']}")
    if report:
        print(f"    report: {report['likely_cause']} ({report['confidence']:.2f}) -> "
              f"{report['template_id']} {report['template_params']}")  # fmt: skip
        print(f"    summary: {report['summary']}")
    if plan:
        print(f"    dry run ok: {plan['dry_run_ok']}; commands:")
        print("      " + plan["commands"].replace("\n", "\n      "))

    if detail["incident"]["status"] == "awaiting_approval":
        action = "reject" if args.reject else "approve"
        reply = api.post(f"/incidents/{incident_id}/{action}", json={"decided_by": "e2e-script"})
        print(f"[{time.monotonic() - started:6.1f}s] {action}: HTTP {reply.status_code}")

    final = wait_for(
        lambda: api.get(f"/incidents/{incident_id}").json(),
        lambda d: d["incident"]["status"] in FINAL,
        timeout_s=900,
        every_s=10,
    )
    print(f"[{time.monotonic() - started:6.1f}s] final status: {final['incident']['status']}")
    print("timeline:")
    first = None
    for event in final["timeline"]:
        at = datetime.fromisoformat(event["time"])
        first = first or at
        payload = event["payload"]
        extra = payload.get("status") or ""
        if "dry_run_ok" in payload:
            extra = f"dry_run_ok={payload['dry_run_ok']}"
        note = payload.get("note", "")
        print(f"  +{(at - first).total_seconds():6.1f}s {event['kind']:17} {extra} {note}")
    return 0 if final["incident"]["status"] in {"resolved", "rejected"} else 1


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
